Export donor-recipient frequency table

Source: R/bridge.R
exportPairFrequencies.Rd

For each transmission pair, creates a table of variant frequencies in the donor and recipient.

Usage

exportPairFrequencies(whe, pairId = NULL, usePassedOnly = TRUE)

Arguments

whe

A WithinHostExperiment with role and pair_id in colData.

pairId

Character (optional). Specific pair to export. If NULL, exports all pairs.

usePassedOnly

Logical. Use only QC-passed variants (default: TRUE).

Value

A DataFrame with columns: chrom, position, ref, alt, donor_freq, recipient_freq, shared (logical) and pair_id. A host carries the allele at a site when its frequency there is known and above 0; shared is TRUE where both hosts carry it. A recorded frequency of 0, such as a site that a table lists without alternative reads, is an assessed site without the allele: it is kept as 0 in its frequency column, and is not shared. A frequency is NA where the host has no call, or its call failed QC. Sites that neither host carries are left out.

Examples

vcf1 <- system.file("extdata", "test_donor.vcf",
    package = "WithinHostExperiment")
vcf2 <- system.file("extdata", "test_recipient.vcf",
    package = "WithinHostExperiment")
whe <- readWithinHost(c(vcf1, vcf2),
    colData = S4Vectors::DataFrame(
        sample_id = c("donor", "recipient"),
        role = c("donor", "recipient"),
        pair_id = c("p1", "p1")),
    caller = "ivar")
exportPairFrequencies(whe)
#> DataFrame with 20 rows and 8 columns
#>            chrom  position         ref         alt donor_freq recipient_freq

#> 5   test_segment       198           A           G       0.22             NA
#> ...          ...       ...         ...         ...        ...            ...
#> 16  test_segment       701           T           G       0.15             NA
#> 17  test_segment       768           G           A       0.27             NA
#> 18  test_segment       812           G           T       0.04             NA
#> 19  test_segment       889           A           C       0.38            0.3
#> 20  test_segment       945           G           A       0.11             NA
#>        shared     pair_id
#>     <logical> <character>

#> 2       FALSE          p1

#> 4       FALSE          p1
